items.title: Ming-Image-0.2-Design: open 6B text-to-image model for graphic design, with RGBA layer decomposition
items.excerpt: inclusionAI released Ming-Image-0.2-Design, an MIT-licensed 6B DiT image model aimed at visual design: e-commerce hero images, UI design drafts and spatial renderings, with stronger text rendering, and it can break a design image into editable transparent RGBA layers down to individual characters. Community MLX and ComfyUI quantizations appeared within a day.
items.rationale: Primary-source open-weights release built for graphic design; RGBA layer decomposition into editable layers is directly usable in a designer's pipeline tomorrow.

items.title: Modu Solution shows Gstar3D cloud CAD that builds 3D models from natural language and drawing images
items.excerpt: At SMATEC 2026, Korean CAD/PLM vendor Modu Solution demoed Gstar3D, a cloud 3D CAD tool that creates parametric models, feature history included, from natural-language commands or JPG/PNG drawing images and exports standard formats such as STEP. It is pre-launch, and an early-user program offers up to 100 people a year of free use.
items.rationale: New text/image-to-parametric-CAD tool with feature history and STEP export plus an open early-user programme; distinct product from the Nomic drafting agent carded 11-26.

items.title: Ukrainian senior UI/UX designer launches module.build, an AI editor that keeps the designer in control
items.excerpt: Designer Bohdan Matviyev built module.build, an editor that merges design and development in one canvas. AI acts as an assistant the user controls rather than an autopilot, with Claude, Codex or Kimi plugged in through the user's own subscriptions or APIs. It reads layouts and components straight from design files to make them dev-ready. It is in closed alpha and positioned against Figma and Paper.
items.rationale: New design-to-dev canvas launch (closed alpha) with bring-your-own-model AI; a fresh entrant in the Figma/Paper space, unrelated to the Runway Dev story it loosely matched.

items.title: Midjourney Unveils 'Niji V8' Anime Image Generation AI
items.excerpt: Midjourney released Niji V8, its anime-style image model, on November 25 (JST). It follows prompts more closely, returns a wider range of candidates per prompt, and is the fastest Niji model yet. Its editing tools can place a reference character into new scenes or poses while keeping the character consistent.
items.rationale: New Midjourney model release with character-consistency editing that illustrators and concept artists can use immediately; second render pick so it gets a palette accent.

items.title: Carlo Ratti and AI assistant to curate Seoul Biennale of Architecture and Urbanism 2027
items.excerpt: Carlo Ratti will curate the 2027 Seoul Biennale of Architecture and Urbanism with an 'unconventional, AI-based' approach, using an AI assistant to rethink exhibition-making. He teased that 'one assistant curator isn't even human.' The theme and team will be revealed on December 8.
items.rationale: Credible-outlet announcement of a major architecture biennale curated with an AI assistant curator; a fresh workflow-category signal that rounds out the category spread.
